newsitem.title: USA: US Sept replacement battery shipments surge 21 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Sept replacement battery shipments surge 21 pct.

text.p: U.S. replacement lead-acid battery shipments surged to 8,143,599 units in September, up 21.49 percent from August as the new batterymaking season kicked-in, the Battery Council International reported.
However, September's total was 8.81 percent down from September last year when 8,930,081 units were shipped.
In the first nine months of 1996, replacement battery shipments totaled 56,551,404 units, up 2.13 percent on 1995.
According to the BCI's 12-month moving total, in the year ended September 1996, shipments totaled 78,231,237 units, up 1.08 percent on the previous 12 months.
